When you meet someone, say mucho gusto (nice to meet you). Example: Hola, me llamo Alex. Tú is close to तुम and is used with friends and familiar coworkers. Usted is close to आप and suits clients, senior people, and new contacts. The question changes too: ¿Cómo estás? for tú and ¿Cómo está? for usted. For a group, use ustedes. In Peru, start with usted, then follow the other person's lead. Unlike Hindi, Spanish puts the verb before its details, so 'Rosa के साथ काम करता हूँ' becomes trabajo con Rosa. Useful words: el trabajo, el correo (email), la oficina, la reunión (meeting).
